big_case.notes: Independent read: a federal receivership over a State's entire prison healthcare system (about 25,000 prisoners, minimum five years), a sovereign applicant with elite counsel, and a PLRA least-intrusive-means question with a CASA-flavored equitable-authority argument give it real weight for state AGs and prison-reform litigators. Against that, the Court handled it as an ordinary in-chambers matter: a single-Justice denial with no referral, no amicus, and no noted dissent, and the live controversy continues on an expedited Ninth Circuit appeal. Moderate significance; low general-public salience. Candour note: I had read each candidate's prediction.json (which carries its big_case_score) before writing this, so the read was formed with those numbers in view, though it was not set from them.
